_comment: Cross-language parity fixture for the Site locations pattern grammar.
A site-location pattern is the Filters grammar (pattern-vectors.json) minus paths and a
wildcard-only host: every valid vector's expected value equals parsePattern(input), so
the host-only grammar is a strict subset of Filters with the identical canonical form.
Each entry is { input, expected } where expected is the canonical stored string, or
null (with a reason) when the input is not a valid site-location pattern. Expected values
are hand-authored (an independent contract), NOT re-derived from either parser.
Additive only: append vectors, never change existing ones.
- a future geospoof-ios Swift parity test (not yet written)

invalid.reason: a bare TLD is not a site
a wildcard only as a leading *.
